Our Company has agreed to purchase 16,000 (Sixteen Thousand only) equity shares of face value of 1 (GBP Only) each, representing76.19% of the equity share capital of Valex,from Mr. Manoj Agarwal, Promoter and Director of our Company, at a price of 42.73per shares(Rs.5,010.81 (Rupees Five Thousand Ten and Paise Eighty-One Only)per share at conversion rate of Rs.117.2668 as on August 7, 2025), aggregating to Rs.8,01,72,960/- (Rupees Eight Crore One Lakh Seventy Two Thousand Nine Hundred Sixty Only); being discharged by way of issue and allotment of 3,33,700 (Three Lakhs Thirty Three Thousand Seven Hundred)Equity Shares of the Company having face value of Rs.10 (Rupees Ten only) each (Subscription Shares)at an issue price of Rs.202.61 (Rupees Two Hundred Two and Paise Sixty One Only)per Equity Share (including a premium of Rs.192.61 (Rupees One Hundred Ninety Two and Paise Sixty One Only)per share), aggregating to Rs.6,76,10,957 (Rupees Six Crore Seventy Six Lakhs Ten Thousand Nine Hundred Fifty Seven Only), on a preferential basis, to the Mr. Manoj Agarwal, Promoter and Director of the Company as a part consideration for the acquisition of Purchase Shares of Valex and the balance consideration ofRs.1,25,62,003/- (Rupees One Crore Twenty Five Lakhs Sixty-Two Thousand Three Only)shall be paid in cash by our Company to Mr. Manoj Agarwal, Promoter and Director of our Company, subject to the applicable laws.



The exiting equity share capital of Valex is 21,000/- (GBP Twenty-One Thousand Only) of face value of 1/- (GBP One Only) each of which 16,000 (Sixteen Thousand Only) equity shares representing 76.19% is held by Mr. Manoj Agarwal. Upon completion of the said acquisition, Valex will become a subsidiary of the Company. Valex is a UK based company engaged in the distribution and wholesale of industrial-grade flexible intermediate bulk containers (FIBCs), commonly known as jumbo bags. Its product portfolio includes customized packaging solutions catering to various sectors, including food-grade and UN-certified industrial applications. Valex sources its products primarily from our Company and offers tailored, compliant, and logistics-efficient solutions across the UK market.This strategic acquisition aligns with the Companys long-term vision expanding its global footprint and directly serve customers in the UK and European regions through a local distribution arm.
